headline: True driver-negative thyroid cancers contain a recurrent arm-CNV residual class concentrated in DM2/FVPTC-like tumors.
pilot_update: cBioPortal ARMDRIVER_CN independently supports the Class6-DM2 signature: 35.4% vs 1.3%, p=1.6e-7.
next_gate: Adjust for FVPTC/Hurthle/purity and move toward manuscript figures.

headline: Bulk-negative TROP2 is rescued as a tumor-specific spatial niche rather than a whole-tumor expression marker.
pilot_update: Haiku-lite pilot: morphology-only rho=-0.044, clinical text rho=0.372, morphology+text rho=0.564, AUROC q75=0.844.
next_gate: Keep as spatial niche; add IHC/IF or actual retrieval-based validation.

headline: Clinical-text conditioned retrieval can separate morphology-visible thyroid programs from molecularly hidden lineage programs.
pilot_update: New pilot supports TROP2 as context-recoverable but not morphology-only; DM1/RAI remain weak/moderate.
next_gate: Implement real retrieval/contrastive embedding and evidence-grounded counterfactual prompts.

headline: DICER1/DGCR8-associated lesions trace a compartment-resolved route from microPTC to PDTC.
pilot_update: GSE301163 GeoMx remains supportive, but genotype/histology are partially confounded.

headline: CAF/ECM ligand programs track spatial thyroid-lineage loss and bulk RAI suppression.

headline: Immune-rich thyroid cancers may represent a protective indolence axis rather than generic aggressive inflammation.

next_gate: External survival cohort; separate Hashimoto-like immune context.
